senses.definition: A deep change in the underlying conditions, big enough to rearrange the landscape.
distractors: Proceeding by small additions, each one small enough to stand and be judged on its own.
The one outcome a team steers by, held fixed while everything else stays negotiable.
A rig that exercises a system from outside to see how it behaves under conditions you pick.
Using far more words than the point needs.
Aware of something and visibly taking it into account.
